$comment: Starting palette (sRGB hex). The asset pipeline converts to OKLab for snapping. Bump styleVersion when the look changes.

direction.chosen: 10/08/2026, Stewart and the main agent, art direction v2
direction.notes: Target look = candidate 1: dense tribal village on a small planet floating in a dark starry sky, brown terraced cliff edges, busy turquoise sea with white foam strokes, chunky pixel resolution, a stone-framed HUD (Shaper portrait with mana bar top-left, spell row, build tools on the right, minimap with population bottom-right). Technique = candidate 3: keep the 3D low-poly world (deformable terrain), render it through the retro pass (low-res target, nearest upscale, palette plus Bayer dither), pixel-noise surface detail, warm firelight. Small traditional tribal figures, the Shaper in feathers and hides with a carved staff, no pointed wizard hat, no glossy mobile look.

render.$comment: Retro render pass (ADR-005). pixelScale 1 and paletteLevels 0 turn the retro look off.

promptStyleSuffix: stylized low-poly game asset, crisp flat-shaded facets, chunky readable shapes, warm earthy palette, warm golden-hour lighting, clean silhouette, plain neutral background, no text, no logo
promptNegative: photorealistic, noisy texture, text, watermark, thin spindly parts, modern objects
